'''Pineek''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] salvager who was famous during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When he was arrested, Pineek offered information on his best scavenging grounds in exchange for securing his freedom, and he was soon freed from [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Mission" />
